headline: Physicswallah Targets Three-Fold Revenue Expansion to Rs 10,000 Crore by FY30
summary: Shares of Physicswallah jumped over 3% after the Indian education platform targeted revenues of Rs 9,000-10,000 crore by FY30, up from Rs 3,900 crore reported in FY26.
why: Physicswallah is an Indian ed-tech firm listed on national exchanges following its recent market debut.
why_moved: Ambitious medium-term revenue expansion targets presented at its investor day lifted buyer interest.
